plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Los Angeles Mission College Catalog 2024-2025 (lamc.edu), program section pp. 62-63: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Biomanufacturing (M043599B) — the upper-division 'COURSE SEQUENCE' (Semesters 1-4), the upper-division course list, and the catalog course descriptions (units and prerequisites). Students enter as juniors with the associate degree in biotechnology (or equivalent): 60 units of lower-division prerequisite coursework (BIOTECH 002/003/006/008, CHEM 101, MATH 227, one of BIOLOGY 003/005/006 or MICRO 020, 24-30 CSU GE/IGETC units, 5-10 CSU transferable electives; stated Total 60) and complete 60 upper-division units at LAMC (degree total 120). Only the officially sequenced upper-division portion is encoded (completion model); the prerequisite block is documented here. Per-course prerequisites are from the catalog course descriptions: BIOTECH 400 <- BIOTECH 310; BIOTECH 410 <- BIOTECH 330 + BIOTECH 340; BIOTECH 460 <- BIOTECH 310; BIOTECH 470 <- BIOTECH 330; CHEM 102 <- CHEM 101 and ENGLISH 420 <- ENGLISH 103 (both in the unsequenced prerequisite block, carried in external_prereqs). 'CSU transferable elective' slots (3/4/3 units, 10 total) are student-choice electives per the official sequence. CATALOG DATA NOTE: the program section's upper-division course list and the BIOTECH 400 course description both give BIOTECH 400 as 4 units, while the 'Course Sequence' column prints 3 for it in Semester 3 — a catalog typo. 4 units is encoded because the section's stated upper-division 'Total 60' reconciles only with 4 (14+19+12+15=60; 59 with 3). The 2025-2026 catalog addendum (May/August/November 2025) makes no changes to this program.
